Highlander vs. Grand Highlander

Grand Highlander is the larger three-row SUV; Highlander is the more compact three-row option.

Which is bigger, the Highlander or the Grand Highlander?

The Grand Highlander is bigger — a stretched three-row family hauler with real room behind the third row.

How much bigger is the Grand Highlander?

Toyota lists it at 201.4 in. long versus 194.9 in. for Highlander. Max cargo room is 97.5 cu. ft. versus 84.3 cu. ft.

Which SUV should my family buy?

Choose Highlander if your third row is occasional. Choose Grand Highlander if adults or cargo ride in it often.

How much can they tow?

Toyota lists up to 5,000 lb towing capacity for both, with some configurations lower.

Do both come as hybrids?

Yes. Toyota offers hybrid versions of both models.

Highlander vs. Grand Highlander FAQs

Is the Grand Highlander bigger?

Yes; it is the larger three-row SUV.

How much bigger is the Grand Highlander?

201.4 in. long versus 194.9 in., and 97.5 cu. ft. cargo versus 84.3 cu. ft.

Which one fits my family better?

If the third row carries adults or gear often, Grand Highlander is the better fit.

How much can they tow?

Toyota lists up to 5,000 lb towing capacity for both; 3,500 lb on most hybrids.
